answer: Make identity costly to fake. Every agent locks stake in a vault before it may attest, and only keys with real locked value earn verification rewards. A sybil operator must then capitalize thousands of separate vaults, while each hollow duplicate — all signature and no stake — earns nothing and can be slashed for false attestations. Reputation here is sable fur: prized precisely because it is hard to counterfeit, so mass impersonation costs more than it can ever return.
